title: Car money vs fare money in cities
text: T-3622 (Malaysia report): inside a city a fare dollar weighs by country income (11.5 min per US$ in Malaysia, 3.4x the US) but a dollar of car costs weighs 3 min everywhere, so the two never match outside rich countries. Make car money weigh like fares (a demand rule change: driving loses riders to rail in poorer countries; ceiling tests rerun; the US can stay where it is), or keep it and add a line to each hover saying why? Recommended: make them equal, as its own measured task.
